title: crataegus × smithii
intro: Crataegus × smithii, commonly known as the hybrid hawthorn, is a cross between the American hawthorn (Crataegus mollis) and the English hawthorn (Crataegus monogyna). This plant is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective properties. The health benefits of Crataegus × smithii include reducing blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and inflammation, as well as improving heart function and overall cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammatory effects.
